Requirements You are in Storm Surge Stance.

You ready your weapon and charge towards your opponent, quick as lightning; with each strike, you zap towards another foe in reach.

Target a creature you could have melee reach with in a single Stride. You Stride towards the target and make a melee Strike. You repeat this up to two more times, each time targeting a different creature you could reach another Stride. After you have made all your attacks, you discharge with an arcing bolt of lightning that passes through each creature you attacked in reverse order. Each creature must make a basic Reflex saving throw or take @Damage[3d12[electricity]] damage. The chain ends if a target critically succeeds at its save. You do not increase your multi-attack penalty until after all of your Strikes are made.
